resources.string: Choose a folder to see your photos and videos.
A wide photo widget for an image or a slideshow from your folders.
Photos are hidden by app lock. Open widget settings to allow them on this widget.
No photos available. Open widget settings to choose another source.
Could not open this photo. Touch and hold the widget, then choose Edit to change its source.
Photos rotate while the launcher displays the widget. Returning to it starts a fresh interval; screen-off time does not advance the slideshow.
Choose whether this widget may display photos while My Media is locked. Opening photos or settings still requires unlocking the app.
Show photos while app lock is enabled
Show photos while the app is locked?

Anyone who can see your home screen will be able to see photos from this widget’s selected sources, even while My Media is locked. Allow applies only to this widget. Opening a photo or widget settings still requires unlocking the app. Deny hides this widget’s photos whenever app lock is enabled.
Add a folder to My Media
Add a folder containing photos to get started. Hidden folders and videos are excluded.
